questions.question: Permission mode for the remotely-spawned sessions?

options.label: default
options.description: Prompts for approval; you approve from phone/browser. Safest for unattended startup.

options.label: acceptEdits
options.description: Auto-accepts file edits, still prompts for other actions.

options.label: dontAsk
options.description: Minimal prompting. Convenient but riskier for unattended servers.

options.label: bypassPermissions
options.description: No prompts at all. Most convenient, least safe.

questions.question: How should the startup job behave over time?

options.label: Self-healing (recommended)
options.description: Runs at login + re-checks every 5 min: restarts any crashed server and auto-picks up newly added dirs under dev.

options.label: Login only (one-shot)
options.description: Launches all 5 once at login. No auto-restart if one crashes; new dirs need re-login.
